build_actor: build an actor loop that unrolls agent-environment interaction for a given number of steps
build_learner: build a learner loop that computes V-trace returns and updates agent weights from actor data
train: train an RL agent on DeepMind Lab levels using importance-weighted actor-learner architecture
test: test a trained RL agent on DeepMind Lab levels and compute human-normalized scores
create_environment: create a DeepMind Lab environment wrapped in a FlowEnvironment with configurable resolution and seed
